verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has an 'AI-powered subject line generator' and a Composer AI feature that drafts content, audience, and send strategy from a brief, matching the core of the story. However, evidence doesn't confirm this is inline inside the standard email composer for refining copy from arbitrary briefs (vs. Composer being a separate AI campaign-building tool) and lacks hands-on detail on the drafting/refining UX. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of in-composer subject-line/copy refinement workflow, independent/hands-on corroboration of quality and usability.
